passages.name: Line 1
passages.text:
Ackergaul: Who dares interrupt me and my work!?

[[Line 2]]

passages.name: Line 2
passages.text:
Ackergaul: This Kelpie is a fine specimen to add to my many, and I shan't let you interrupt me!

[[Line 3]]

passages.name: Line 3
passages.text:
Wilfred: Yeah... I don't think so. I don't think I like your way of treating these creatures. Or witches.

[[Line 4]]

passages.name: Line 4
passages.text:
Wilfred: And I especially don't like the way you treated my mother!

[[Line 5]]

passages.name: Line 5
passages.text:
Ackergaul: I am doing them a favour! I am purging them from the demonic entities that possess them!

[[Line 6]]

passages.name: Line 6
passages.text:
Wilfred: I think we both have a different definition of a favour! 

[[Line 7]]

passages.name: Line 7
passages.text:
Wilfred: You are not the decider of what is right and what is wrong!

[[Line 8]]

passages.name: Line 8
passages.text:
Ackergaul: I certainly have more power to decide that than you! The people trust my research!

[[Line 9]]

passages.name: Line 9
passages.text:
Wilfred: Oh? Because you are a "respectable doctor"? You are nothing but a murderer! Your morals mean nothing here!

[[Line 10]]

passages.name: Line 10
passages.text:
Meone: Meow!

[[Line 11]]

passages.name: Line 11
passages.text:
Ackergaul: I knew I could sense something! A demonic entity has attached itself to that cat!

[[Line 12]]

passages.name: Line 12
passages.text:
Ackergaul: It must be cleansed immediately! Hand the fiend over at once!

[[Line 13]]

passages.name: Line 13
passages.text:
Meone: MEOW!

[[Line 14]]

passages.name: Line 14
passages.text:
Wilfred: Don't worry Meone! I won't let him hurt you! Stay behind me. This guy is mine.

[[Line 15]]

passages.name: Line 15
passages.text:
Meone: Meow...

[[Line 16]]

passages.name: Line 16
passages.text:
Ackergaul: This cat is flawed. Possessed by evil. I can fix it! I can make it better!

[[Line 17]]

passages.name: Line 17
passages.text:
Wilfred: Meone is fine as she is. Possessed!? She is just a cat!

[[Line 18]]

passages.name: Line 18
passages.text:
Ackergaul: You wouldn't understand! Fine. Have it your way. I'll have to take it by force!

[[Line 19]]

passages.name: Line 19
passages.text:
Wilfred: (This doctor is insane! Why is he so convinced that he is a saviour to the people!?)

[[Line 20]]

passages.name: Line 20
passages.text: Wilfred: (...a saviour...? No! I am NOT like Ackergaul!)
